title: Truncated Gaussian first moment
statement: Let $\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian density on $\mathbb R$. For every $t\in\mathbb R$, its first moment over $(-\infty,t]$ satisfies $\int_{(-\infty,t]}x\varphi(x)\,dx=-\varphi(t)$.
replaced:
Let $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$ be the standard Gaussian density. For every real $t$, its truncated first moment with respect to Lebesgue measure is
\[
\int_{(-\infty,t]}x\varphi(x)\,dx=-\varphi(t).
\]
